_meta.description: HUNTFLOW Scrapling crawl sources — each category maps to a list of job boards.

schema.category: string — board category key (remote | europe | mena | global | posts). Requesting category 'all' sweeps every category.
schema.id: string — unique board id (used for board_id on crawled jobs).
schema.name: string — display name surfaced as the job's source.
schema.url: string — listing URL the crawler fetches.
schema.type: 'static' | 'stealth' | 'posts' — static = TLS-impersonated HTTP fetch; stealth = real stealth browser (JS-heavy pages); posts = forum/thread whose posts are parsed as hiring posts.

selectors.item: CSS selector matching each job card (or comment row for posts boards).
selectors.title: CSS selector, or one of the special tokens 'text' / 'href' / 'domain', or a literal string.
selectors.text: posts boards only — CSS selector for the full post text that gets parsed for the '| Company |' block.

schema.keyword: optional — board-level keyword override; defaults to the crawl request keyword.
schema.maxCards: optional — per-board card cap (defaults to the remaining request limit).
schema._comment: optional human note about the board.

how_to_add_a_board: 1. Add a new top-level category key (or reuse an existing one) mapping to a list of board objects.
2. Give each board an id, name, url, type, and selectors.
3. For structured job listing pages set type to 'static' or 'stealth' and provide CSS selectors for item/title/company/location/url.

4. For forum hiring threads (e.g. HN Who is Hiring) set type to 'posts' and set selectors.item to the comment rows plus selectors.text to the post body; the agent parses the leading '| Company |' block.
5. Literal field values (e.g. location 'Remote', company 'YCombinator Network') are returned as-is; selectors like 'h4' or 'span.titleline > a' are resolved per card.
6. Restart the sidecar (uv run uvicorn server:app --port 8001) to pick up changes.

remote.name: RemoteOK
remote._comment: RemoteOK serves empty placeholder rows statically (infinite scroll) — set type to 'stealth' if you want real cards via the browser path.

remote.name: WeWorkRemotely
remote._comment: Server-rendered board; the item selector also matches the filter tabs, which the keyword filter drops.

remote.name: FMHY Remote Directory
remote._comment: A link directory, not a real job board — low precision, mostly filtered by keyword. Included for coverage.

europe.name: Welcome to the Jungle Europe
europe._comment: JS-heavy job board — stealth browser required; selectors may drift as the SPA re-renders.

europe.name: EuropeRemotely
europe._comment: Currently returns 403 to the fetcher; kept for when the site reopens access.

mena.name: Keejob Tunisia
mena._comment: Tunisian job board — card markup changed recently; extraction is best-effort.

mena.name: Tanqeeb MENA & Qatar
mena._comment: MENA/Qatar board; the search page currently returns few/no cards statically.

global.name: HackerNews Who is Hiring
global._comment: Directory of the monthly Who-is-Hiring threads; the real posts are parsed by the hacker_news_who_is_hiring posts board.

global.name: HackerNews Jobs
global._comment: YC/HN jobs front page — server-rendered, 30 rows of startup roles linking to ycombinator.com careers pages.

posts.name: HN Who is Hiring
posts._comment: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026). Each comment is parsed for the leading '| Company | Role | Location | Salary' block. Update the ?id= to the current month's thread (see /submitted?id=whoishiring) as it is posted on the first weekday of each month.

posts.name: HN Remote Who is Hiring
posts._comment: Same monthly thread filtered to remote roles — a keyword-only variant of hacker_news_who_is_hiring that keeps the deck remote-focused.
